name: nayacura
description: Nayacura — premium confidential sexual wellness and relationship healthcare platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push -w backend && npm run db:seed -w backend
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:reset -w backend && npm run db:seed -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
